adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a path where imported content is rendered without Discourse’s normal cooking/sanitization: `Post#cook` now returns `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: ...[:raw_html]` (app/models/topic_embed.rb), and the embed view renders it with `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Additionally, feed polling passes through `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), which can contain attacker-controlled HTML. The cited spec indeed only uses benign ``/`` in `contents` and does not exercise script/event-handler payloads, so this XSS-relevant behavior has no test coverage.
